content.scenario: The government of Maharashtra is setting up a new District Council in Pune. The Collector of Pune district is appointed as the Chairperson, and other members are to be selected.
content.outcome: The District Council in Pune shall consist of the Collector of the district as the Chairperson and other official and non-official members representing prescribed interests, as may be prescribed by the government.

user_queries: Who is the Chairperson of the District Council?
What is the composition of the District Council?
How are members of the District Council selected?
